# BurnLoop

BurnLoop is an iPhone app for general wellness and educational meal guidance. Users can state health goals, allergies, and relevant health conditions, plan meals, scan food, and receive nutrition-related context plus practical next-step ideas.

## Important safety information

BurnLoop does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent disease. It does not replace medical care, prescribed treatment, medication guidance, or advice from a qualified clinician.

## Key pages

- https://burnloopai.com/ — Product overview
- https://burnloopai.com/diabetes — Diabetes-aware meal-guidance education
- https://burnloopai.com/cholesterol — Cholesterol-friendly meal-planning education

## Pricing

- Free download on iPhone
- BurnLoop Pro monthly subscription: $4.99 USD, subject to App Store availability and terms
